step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates ITT Star's AI/ML image processing pipeline for luxury goods brand and pricing guidance. The workflow starts with web and mobile users interacting via AWS Amplify UI. Amplify sends API requests to Amazon API Gateway, which integrates with Amazon Cognito for user authentication. Upon authentication, users upload raw inventory images/videos through API Gateway into an Amazon S3 bucket. An S3 bucket creation event triggers an AWS Lambda function. Lambda invokes Amazon Rekognition (trained with 100,000+ luxury item images) to identify brands and features. Next, Amazon Textract extracts textual details (such as serial numbers or brand text) embedded within or adjacent to the image and correlates them with identified features. Finally, all extracted metadata is saved into Amazon DynamoDB as structured JSON for extensible downstream processing.
